text: In the evening, after coming home from work, lie on your back and raise your legs up, placing them against the wall. Relax and lie like this for 7-12 minutes. But the "secret" is not in the pose, but in the breathing: lengthen the exhalation (for example, inhale for 4, exhale for 8). This gently unloads the nervous system, helps venous outflow, and reduces “noise” in the head. Do this every evening, and soon you will notice that evenings pass differently, and even your sleep becomes deeper.
